ac:layout-cell.h1: Customer Offboarding Sequence and Reuse Assessment
ac:layout-cell.p: Solution Summary · Logical Feature Specification · Feature folder

This separate draft assesses how the proposed OFF journey in SPEC-SEI-003 could use existing APIs and shared capabilities. It adds saved FR disconnection evidence, Spain/provider differences, export dependencies and engineering qualification gates. The predecessor remains unchanged and selected for stable Confluence page 923861391.

Existing OFF-INT-01–10 and OFF-D01–09 remain proposed logical operations/records in the predecessor. They are not newly approved endpoints or deployment boundaries. Support periods, historical authority, archive terms and production implementation coverage remain open. No new API is designed here.

Check the existing onboarding, connection, routing, lifecycle and records APIs before adding an exit API. A connection DELETE may support one removal step in OFF-06. It does not complete the whole exit. The exit also needs permission, a list of affected work, the applicable G3 check, responsibility for earlier invoices, records access and data-handling rules. SPEC032 §1 defines the customer scenarios. Its OFF-S01–10 are not new API operations. REF-PRODUCT; INT-AP03.

tr.td: Sage private-platform departure
Retain shared OFF gates and qualify the actual Sage connector's address/direction removal.
Present requested versus observed outcome and stop only selected new traffic. Do not label 202 as completed exit.
External private-platform departure
Bind each operator's contract, authority, notice, export and observation behaviour.
Show provider-owned/manual steps and blockers. No promise of universal automated removal.
Product-only cancellation
Separate product entitlement from platform agreement and historical/archive access.
Establish a usable post-cancellation login/request path and scope. Current implementation unknown.
Historical processing
Reuse invoice origin, lifecycle obligations, reports and case recovery.
Permit only confirmed historical operations after cutoff; preserve unselected scope.
Export and disposition
Reuse records/retrieval and secure delivery where qualified.
Expose scope, snapshot, omissions, readiness, retrieval and acceptance separately. No evidenced complete offboarding export API is supplied.
Public destination or direct recovery
Reuse qualified public access/retrieval where the actor is authorised.
Public technical readiness is not permission to deregister another provider or replace all private records.
End Sage access to SPFE — OFF-S01
Qualify selected Sage access removal and any separately requested representation change.
Record continuing actor/channel and independent results. No supplied contract establishes SPFE customer deregistration. OFF-Q02/04.
Public-to-private switch — OFF-S02
Onboarding qualifies the destination; routing owns one enabled receiving change.
Preserve earlier public context. Exact publication/change sequence, applicable duties and implementation coverage remain GAP-06.
Business closure or incident — OFF-S09/10
Reuse scoped evidence review and incident controls where proven.
Cessation needs an evidenced G3 branch. Incident containment cannot wait for G3/G5; subsequent switching or exit needs separate qualification.

ac:layout-cell.p: The scope is Spain. Shared gates, case patterns and audit controls are design-reuse candidates. Spain identity, publication, public-copy/reporting and data-policy bindings remain local. Existing implementation coverage is unknown until the selected build, contract and operations pass the gates below. Terms follow the glossary.

These tables describe proposed logical sequences, not an approved allocation to services. Actors and shared capabilities can map to existing components after engineering review. A country/provider boundary represents the relevant rules and external contract.

tr.td: Authorised customer/product → existing case/authority capabilities: request exact scope and terms.
OFF-01/02, R12: authority, dependency inventory and exit statement; no external mutation.
Transition owner → destination operator and routing capabilities: qualify destination and record intended boundary.
OFF-03: observe supported direction, destination and receiving-publication conditions; block if unproved.
Transition owner → shared routing and country/provider action: commit and observe one scoped cutoff.
OFF-04: expected/actual route version and independently observed provider state. Unknown effects enter OFF-08.
Historical owner → original invoice/lifecycle capabilities: finish or hand over earlier work.
OFF-05: original identifiers, due dates, actor/channel and accepted handover. No automatic replay via destination.
Release owner → qualified update/disconnect operation; notification/detail observation confirms result.
OFF-06: choose address, direction or whole-connection action only after dependency checks. INT-AP02/03; address absence alone is insufficient.
Records/customer → qualified export/archive capabilities: validate package and record delivery/disposition.
OFF-07, R13: export can begin earlier. Completion evidence and later schedules are separate from disconnect.

ac:layout-cell.p: For destination adoption, use the current onboarding sequence assessment, SPEC039. The previous operator's release is independently evidenced. A combined request uses one coordinated transition, not competing route commits in onboarding and offboarding. Public-access-only exit uses the continuing-channel G3 branch; business closure uses OFF-S09. OFF-S10 containment precedes this planned sequence when required and does not itself authorise a new route. REF-PRODUCT; SPEC-SEI-014 SPC-04/08.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 2.2 Unknown disconnection or late provider evidence

tr.td: Product/operations receives timeout, 202, event or incomplete detail.
Keep original action/correlation and selected scope. An event is a prompt to observe, not proof of every exit gate.
Recovery owner → qualified state/detail query or provider support: observe original result.
INT-AP03/05/06 do not supply a universal original-operation reconciliation guarantee. Missing query coverage is GAP-02.
Recovery owner compares intended action with observed addresses/provider records and remaining invoices.
Absent address may follow failed creation as well as removal. Correlate action history and provider evidence.
Recovery owner resumes, conflicts or holds the same transition under evidenced safety rules.
No blind DELETE/recreate, no reset of prior invoice origin and no dependent credential deletion.

ac:layout-cell.p: INT-AP06's platform-managed retry horizon and INT-AP05's seven-day error observations are source-specific. Neither defines this feature's support period, retry permission or audit retention. Capture required evidence before a source observation expires. Conflicting guide retry/escalation wording stays unqualified.

tr.td: Records owner → invoice, lifecycle and exit sources: inventory and authorise a snapshot.
OFF-D03/06/08; distinguish held records, obtainable external evidence and gaps.
Qualified retrieval → original provider/public download where authorised.
Fetch missing allowed files using the actual contract. Preserve source-original versus public-copy classification. SPFE-S02/03/12/13.
Export capability → authorised recipient: deliver validated package/manifest through a scoped channel.
OFF-R13/14; no supplied endpoint establishes this whole operation. GAP-04.
Customer/destination → exit case: acknowledge received version; accept historical obligations separately where applicable.
Download receipt does not prove import, legal authority or operational handover.
Historical processing → Records: supply later deltas and disposition evidence.
Keep ongoing duties and data-class schedules owned after general access ends. OFF-R12/13.

ac:layout-cell.h3: How the onboarding APIs support a platform switch
ac:layout-cell.p: The complete customer switch journey is defined once in SPEC038. This assessment covers the APIs and exit work used by that journey; it does not define another customer switch process.

The customer starts one Switch platform request in E-invoicing settings, as defined in SPEC038. The API steps below support that single journey. Separate API calls do not require separate customer onboarding and offboarding requests.

The existing onboarding APIs can support connection setup during a switch. The saved contracts do not define a single API call that completes a platform switch. SPEC039 §3.4 owns the onboarding sequence; SPEC040 owns the call examples. REF-ONB-API.

tr.td: Set up a missing connection to the selected access point
API-03 — Connect: POST /connectors/{accessPointId}/datasets/{datasetId}/connect
Creates a dataset/access-point connection with initial addresses.
How Spain platforms map to accessPointId and connections, required provider inputs, and SPFE applicability. Do not assume every switch needs a new connection. Onboarding GAP-02/04/06.
Change setup within an existing connection
API-05 — Update setup: PUT /connectors/{accessPointId}/datasets/{datasetId}/connections/{connectionId}/
Adds an address with action: "add" or changes an existing address's effectiveDate and/or endDate with action: "update". Both actions can be in one request.

Spain address rules, supported providers and exact deployed version. This PUT does not move an existing connection to another accessPointId or complete a platform migration. Later guide claims about removal remain separate from saved FR-05. Onboarding GAP-02/06/07/08.
Check the setup result
API-04 — Read connection: GET /connectors/{accessPointId}/datasets/{datasetId}/connections/{connectionId}/
Returns documented connection/address details for the selected connection.
Completion evidence, current state and Spain support. A 200, CONNECTED or address result alone does not prove that invoice routing changed. Onboarding GAP-05/06; offboarding GAP-02.
Start using the new platform and end selected old access
Routing controls in SPEC-SEI-014, then applicable OFF-04/06 actions
The design requires one authorised change for new invoices, with earlier work kept separate.
No approved routing-change endpoint is established by API-03/05. Confirm start, earlier-invoice access, old-provider actions and recovery. Onboarding GAP-06/08; offboarding GAP-01/02/05/06.

ac:layout-cell.p: Engineering must confirm the selected Spain model and running API version before this reuse is called supported. Private A → private B remains disabled in current onboarding scope. Keep API IDs and gap owners aligned with SPEC039/040; do not create a second switch implementation in offboarding.
ac:layout-cell.h3: 3.1 Saved FR contracts and guide evidence

tr.th: Source capability and exact evidenced operation

tr.td: INT-AP02; PUT /connectors/{accessPointId}/datasets/{datasetId}/connections/{connectionId}/. Saved FR-05 OpenAPI 1.0.0.

Candidate for scoped date/address changes. The later guide describes remove from API v1.1.0 and usage changes; do not silently add those to the saved schema. Spain address identity and granularity need binding.
GAP-01; FR API and provider owners: pin OpenAPI/build, action enum, usage semantics, dates and partial effects. Test OFF-A20/23.
INT-AP03 guide; DELETE /connectors/{accessPointId}/datasets/{datasetId}/connections/{connectionId}; response 202 with no success body.
Whole-connection disconnection candidate. Guide sequence includes a trailing slash while the operation card does not. It cannot safely implement partial exit unless the full affected scope is proven.
GAP-01/02; connector owner: actual signature, provider coverage, authority, acknowledgement and recovery. No saved complete DELETE OpenAPI was supplied.
INT-AP03/06; e-invoicing.accesspointconnection.updated, followed by detail read.
Reuse notification/observation pattern. Guide states no separate offboarding event. Do not create a fictional DEACTIVATED status; removed/expired addresses disappear.
GAP-02; API/Operations owners: event/correlation, duplicate/out-of-order delivery, address-specific outcomes and authoritative external confirmation.
FR-04; GET /connectors/{accessPointId}/datasets/{datasetId}/connections/{connectionId}/; OpenAPI 1.0.0.
Candidate for saved connection/address observation; does not alone prove correct legal entity mapping or original action outcome. INT-AP05 has failed-absent-address evidence.
GAP-02/03; API/Identity owners: freshness, history, missing resource semantics, shared scope and source reconciliation.
INT-AP06; GET /datasets/{datasetId}/accesspoints.
Recover known dataset connector/connection references. Dataset CONNECTED/DISCONNECTED is too coarse to establish selected-address release or complete customer exit.
GAP-03; dataset owner: actual dataset/entity/address cardinality and isolation. Do not assume one dataset always means one entity.
Dataset provisioning/deletion, INT-DS01.
Saved guide says external dataset deletion is unavailable and points to support; its prerequisite wording also mentions delete. Treat deletion availability as unresolved.
GAP-03; dataset owner: contract and manual process. Dataset deletion is not a substitute for connection removal, record disposition or mandate withdrawal.

ac:layout-cell.p: Keep exact source field names and provider statuses. INT-AP05's upstream error strings must not become Spain errors or public invoice-report states. A supported request can still have partial, unknown or provider-rejected results.

tr.th: Unknown coverage, owner and evidence gate

tr.td: SPEC-SEI-003 OFF-INT-01–03/10, D01–03/09: case, authority and inventory
Reuse scoped request, audit, blockers and original-operation recovery patterns. Bind actual authority and customer access after product cancellation.
GAP-03/05; Identity/Operations/Product owners: existing builds, entitlement/retention behaviour, multi-client isolation and runbook. Design reuse only until demonstrated.
SPEC-SEI-014 SPC-04/07/08; OFF-INT-04/05, D04/05: routing
Reuse one route transition and preserved invoice context. Bind Spain receiving publication and each operator's sequence.
GAP-01/06; Routing/provider owners: transaction boundary, concurrency, staged cutoff and external observations.
SPEC-SEI-009 and lifecycle SEI030; OFF-INT-06, D06: earlier obligations
Reuse event provenance, independent reporting results and cases. Bind post-switch actor/channel and purpose-limited access.
GAP-05; Legal/Tax, lifecycle and provider owners: authority, actual old-invoice operations, recipient/issuer distinction, duplicates and deadlines.
SPEC-SEI-016 and retrieval SEI027; OFF-INT-08, D08: records/download
Reuse authorised stored-file retrieval and preservation patterns. Add exit snapshot, manifest, deltas and post-cancellation access only where missing.
GAP-04; Records/Product owners: original coverage, package completeness, size/resume limits, delivery and accepted custody. Existing full export implementation unknown.
SPEC-SEI-008 DTS
Preferred transformation candidate where an additional export syntax or readable representation is required. Preserve source files as separate evidence.
GAP-04; DTS/Records owners: deployed build, accepted contracts, exact mappings, country rule packs, fidelity and operations. No transformation is needed merely to copy unchanged source bytes.
Existing security/credential and commercial capabilities; OFF-INT-07, D07
Reuse independent release, least privilege and shared-dependency checks. Bind scope/entitlement/mandate to actual provider contracts.
GAP-03/05; Security/Commercial/provider owners: post-exit restricted mode, revocation, incident exceptions and contract separation.

ac:layout-cell.p: SPFE-S02 Articles 9–11 establish recovery/download and access context. The supplied service catalogue and WSDLs establish particular query, download and event operations. They supply no named platform-offboarding or archive-transfer operation. This is a limit of the supplied snapshot, not proof that no later capability exists. OFF-Q04 requires current contract qualification.

tr.td: SPFE-S15 GetRegisteredInvoice; SPFE-S14 GetInvoices
Candidate inventory discovery and identifier consultation under qualified authority.
Metadata consultation does not supply invoice files or a complete private-provider history. Query coverage/checkpoints need proof.
SPFE-S12 DownloadInvoicesByID; SPFE-S13 DownloadInvoicesByLOC
Candidate file acquisition for an authorised evidence package.
Downloaded public original/copy must keep its classification. Batch limits and authorization differ; do not infer a complete exit export from a successful batch.
SPFE-S11 CustomerInvoiceEvents; SPFE-S17 SupplierInvoiceEvents
Candidate continued reporting through an authorised channel.
Contracts do not assign the post-switch actor or grant a new platform authority over old invoices. OFF-Q02 remains open.
SPFE-S08 formats and referenced XSDs
Bind the selected public operation's transport/schema when reused.
Formats v0.1.0 is draft with pending sections; header XSDs are not a complete business/exit schema. Existing SPFE conflicts remain gates.

ac:layout-cell.p: The detailed public retrieval/reporting contracts stay in their owning feature specs. No new public endpoint, country default or country-neutral copy/reporting rule is introduced by this set.

tr.td: GAP-01 Removal scope and provider sequence
Pin the actual version/build and country/provider contract; qualify address/direction/whole-connection removal, notice, dates, receiving propagation and shared dependencies.
Connector/Routing/provider owners; blocks affected automated cutoff/release. OFF-Q04.
GAP-02 Completion and reconciliation
Demonstrate action correlation, state freshness, asynchronous completion, timeouts, absent-address ambiguity, partial effects and retry safety.
API/Operations/provider owners; no 202-to-complete shortcut. OFF-A05/23.
GAP-03 Entity, relationship and post-exit access
Qualify dataset/entity/address mapping, delegate authority, platform versus product contract, independent credentials and actual restricted login/access.
Identity, dataset, Product/Commercial/Security owners; blocks unsupported partial release or historical/export access promise. OFF-A13/20.
GAP-04 Export and accepted custody
Demonstrate inventory coverage, exact originals/copies, events/receipts, secure resumable delivery, manifest integrity, delta generation, destination import and data disposition.
Records, retrieval, DTS and destination owners; blocks complete-export or transferred-custody claim. OFF-Q05; OFF-A18/19/25.
GAP-05 Earlier duties and time periods
Resolve OFF-Q01/02/03/06 with product terms, legal roles, applicable rights, retention schedules, permitted actors/channels and operational escalation.
Product/Operations/Legal/Tax/Privacy/Security/providers; blocks dependent expiry, credential release or deletion. OFF-A16/17/21/22.
GAP-06 Current Spain evidence and isolation
Qualify authoritative receiving change sequence, public access/representation, cross-provider work and applicable effective dates. Keep all local rules out of another country's defaults.
Spain Compliance and platform owners; blocks affected activation. OFF-A10/24.

ac:layout-cell.p: For each gap, record a named owner, source/version, tested build/environment, date and accepted result before passing its gate. A missing automated capability can use a controlled manual step only where the contract and authority permit it.

tr.td: Partial disconnect compatibility
Run selected-address/direction removal against the pinned build while another address/entity/direction remains active. Check observations and event payloads. OFF-A12/20/23; GAP-01/03.
Unknown effect and duplicate recovery

Simulate timeout after provider acceptance, repeated/out-of-order events and lost internal persistence. Observe the original action; no duplicate removal/recreate or historical resend. OFF-A03/05/14/23; GAP-02.
Post-cancellation authorisation

End the product entitlement, exercise permitted historical/export/copy paths, reject new-traffic and revoked-delegate attempts, then revoke only dependencies that have ended. OFF-A13/16/17/20/22; GAP-03/05.
Export completeness and handover

Compare source inventory to package/manifest, open all parts, validate relationships/hashes, simulate missed/late records and expired links, and distinguish receipt from accepted obligations. OFF-A18/19/21/25; GAP-04.
Country and provider regression
Show that Spain bindings do not change FR address/status meanings or another provider's removal rules. An unqualified provider cannot pass through a shared default. OFF-A10/24; GAP-06.

ac:layout-cell.p: These checks are evidence requirements, not executed tests. API documentation alone does not establish availability, conformance, export coverage or production readiness.

ac:layout-cell.p: The original-file inventory and authority limits remain in RES-SEI-002. The local examples and English extracts are reading aids, not proof of field-mapping completeness or implementation readiness. Copy-right and privacy sources, with their limits, are in SPEC-SEI-032 REF beside the owning behaviour.
